"""Record one actual implementation check without overwriting previous evidence."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path('/workspace/scratch/d417066aafa8/agent-dev-kit')
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE = ROOT / 'tests/test_skill_command_examples.py'


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


name, *command = sys.argv[1:]
target = OUT / name
target.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
environment = dict(os.environ, PATH=str(ROOT / '.venv/bin') + ':/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin',
                   PYTHONPATH=str(ROOT / 'src'))
before = SOURCE.read_bytes()
(target / 'source-before.py').write_bytes(before)
started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
started = time.monotonic()
result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=environment, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
ended_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
(target / 'stdout.log').write_bytes(result.stdout)
(target / 'stderr.log').write_bytes(result.stderr)
after = SOURCE.read_bytes()
summary = {
    'command': command, 'cwd': str(ROOT), 'started_at': started_at, 'ended_at': ended_at,
    'elapsed_seconds': elapsed, 'exit_code': result.returncode,
    'source_before_sha256': digest(before), 'source_after_sha256': digest(after),
    'source_unchanged_during_command': before == after,
    'stdout_sha256': digest(result.stdout), 'stderr_sha256': digest(result.stderr),
}
(target / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
print(result.stdout.decode(errors='replace')[-12000:])
print(result.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[-12000:])
sys.exit(result.returncode)
